recipient_role_policy.manifest_rule: Every document or clause containing a tag must declare the intended recipient roles, and every signer role in that manifest must have at least one assigned field.

document_safety_policy.official_limit: Zoho documents the feature for documents less than 75 pages.
document_safety_policy.rule: Keep each tag on one physical line with ASCII {{ }}, straight double quotes, and no hidden line breaks. This registry intentionally forbids width-padding spaces so source scans remain deterministic.

mandatory_marker_policy.rule: Zoho documents the asterisk as the mandatory marker for text fields and checkboxes. It is not a Sign Date modifier, so GHRE forbids it on SD; Sign Date is populated automatically after signing. Existing simple signature and initial tags with a redundant asterisk are accepted for compatibility but the asterisk does not change their required behavior.

canonical_sign_date_policy.recipient_rule: Encode exactly one explicit R1-R25 recipient role per Sign Date tag and repeat the canonical tag separately for every recipient who needs a signing timestamp.
canonical_sign_date_policy.mandatory_marker_rule: Do not add *. Sign Date is system-populated after that recipient signs; Zoho documents the mandatory marker only for text fields and checkboxes.
canonical_sign_date_policy.verification_rule: The exact R1 syntax passed user-confirmed Zoho Contracts-to-Zoho Sign preview conversion in ordinary body text on 2026-07-17. A narrow table cell can wrap or page-split the source tag and prevent conversion. Keep the complete tag on one physical line and complete both a table-placement preview check and a post-signature value check before publishing a live template.

evidence_policy.officially_documented_grammar: Syntax recorded from Zoho's current automatic-field-addition help page.
evidence_policy.rule: Official grammar, observed Contracts-to-Sign behavior, and tenant smoke-test evidence are separate facts. A documented tag is not automatically approved for this integration path.

tested_families: other combined shorthand and longhand recipient expressions
multiple_recipient_field_ownership.observation: Some combined-recipient Sign Date variants produced a field, but Zoho assigned that field only to the first parsed recipient. Field formation is therefore a false positive and is not evidence of joint ownership.
multiple_recipient_field_ownership.rule: One Sign field has one recipient owner. Use one separate canonical tag for R1, R2, R3, and every other intended recipient; combined-recipient tags are invalid.

table_cell_sign_date.observation: A formatted Sign Date tag converted in ordinary document body text, while the same kind of long tag remained literal after wrapping over multiple lines in a narrow table cell; one observed tag was split across a page boundary. A shorter date-only Sign Date field was present in a table and displayed the editor format dd MMM yyyy.
table_cell_sign_date.official_rule: Zoho requires every text tag to remain on one physical line and states that a tag moved to the next line will not be detected. Zoho publishes no separate table-specific Sign Date grammar.
table_cell_sign_date.production_rule: Keep the canonical MM/dd/yyyy hh:mm a z tag unchanged, widen or merge the Date cell or reduce only the source-tag font until the raw tag remains on one physical line, and disable Allow row to break across pages. Verify field ownership in preview and the populated timestamp after signing. If layout cannot preserve one line, use a native Sign Date field or the short {{SD:R1}} fallback and set the custom format in the Zoho Sign field properties; do not silently publish a noncanonical text tag.
